verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST v3 API and BILL Elements, an official embeddable UI widget library you can drop into apps "with just a few lines of code". That counts as a thin, front-end form of official SDK. There is no evidence of official language client SDKs (e.g., Python, Node, Java) for the API, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404, so generated clients are not evidenced either. Missing for 10: official language client SDKs for the API, a published OpenAPI spec for codegen, SDK docs/repos, independent corroboration.
